changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Cost, Delivery and Finance Crew route with exact cost/change/savings artifacts, pending setup and executable verification checks.
Scopes setup to small engineering teams and defaults to one workflow unless access or lifecycle boundaries require a split.
Defaults human approvals to durable asynchronous review: preparation ends pending review and a later action validates the recorded decision and current state.
Adds an explicit inspect-first discovery step, focused customer questions, recorded user direction, and a clear boundary that installation is not approval.

title: Cost Anomaly to Verified Savings
description: Connect a sourced cloud-cost change to a reviewed engineering action and a finance-verified savings outcome, keeping estimates separate from realized billed results.
setup_prompt: Treat Cost Anomaly to Verified Savings as a proposal. Inspect my existing Crews, billing account and basis, service ownership, utilization, IaC and finance sources. Propose reuse or creation of Cloud Cost Analyst, Engineering Delivery Coordinator and Finance Analyst, exact artifact validators, a bounded manual first run and owner reviews before any infrastructure action. Show the concrete plan in Builder chat before configuration. Selecting the Playbook creates no Crew, change, payment, schedule or verified savings claim.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized account, service, resource, environment and owner
Currency, billing basis, allocation and comparable period rule
Cost/usage, resource/health, IaC/deployment and finance sources or exports
Allowed optimization, approval, rollback and reliability limits
Post-change billing and health verification rule or pending-evidence decision
Manual-only or reviewed recurrence with timezone and budget

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether optimization supports business priorities without harming service goals
Savings quality, opportunity cost, and risk appetite
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

Validated cloud-cost review and owner decision
Reviewed exact change proposal with separate approval and deployment evidence
Pending or verified finance savings readout with comparable billing and health evidence
Manual first run and paused recurrence decision
